Information
Yoga Happy Hour Thursday, December 3 6:30PM No Cover | Pay What you can \ $10 Suggested We're excited to announce outdoor yoga at Atomic this fall. Join Casey A'Blaze for 6 weeks of fun playlists, bold movement, and beautiful autumn weather at the Atomic Pavilion. Doors at 5pm. Yoga 6:30pm Happy Hour Specials until 8pm. Hosted By: Casey A'Blaze @caseyablaze Location: Atomic Pavilion, 4140 Manchester St Louis, MO Yoga Happy Hour is pay what you can and open to the public. All skill levels are welcome. Class will involve laying down and kneeling on the ground. A chair will be available if this difficult for you. Please inform the instructor of any physical needs.

Also check out other Sports events in St. Louis.
